notes.note: A team must be at or under the cap before each RFA match (a match may take it over). Gibbs is matched first in 2027 and puts Jordan over, so his second 2027 RFA slot is unusable: no trading for expiring players to keep by RFA (Chase Brown, Rice dropped). Rule now in league.yaml match_requires_under_cap.

years.note: over the cap through the last RFA match (allowed); nothing bought at auction, $0 leftovers only

plan_steps.text: Over the cap after the plan: only $0 adds until the auction is over (leftovers).

scenarios.scenario: Match Gibbs, Lamb to the auction

principles: P10 kickers and defenses are streamed weekly; P18 values: this season by simulated payout, later seasons at $0.53 a lineup point (1.6 lineup points per $1 of salary); next season's cap is real money, in-season cap is worth little; trade ideas are not offers until Jordan proposes them.
sources: config/owner_plans.yaml, data/journal/strategy_notes.csv, future.json (outlook and offseason scenarios)
